---
name: Incident update (shows on the status page)
about: Post a plain-language note about a problem we are fixing
title: "<Service name> is not working"
labels: status
assignees: ''

---

**What people will notice**
Example: "Sign-in may fail for a few minutes."

**Is my information safe?**
Example: "Yes. Nothing was lost."

**What we are doing**
Example: "We found the cause and are fixing it now."

**What you can do**
Example: "Close the app, wait 10 minutes and try again."

---
_Update this issue at least every 60 minutes while it is open. Close it when the checks are green again. Link the post-incident review (Incident issue in the affected repo) before closing._
